name: gmail
title: Gmail
description: A Gmail mailbox reached over IMAP and SMTP — an address and an app password.
needed_for: Reads your Gmail inbox into conversations.
justification: A Gmail data source reads the mailbox over IMAP and sends over SMTP as you. Google accepts an app password for that, never the account password.

GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.label: App password
GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.hint: Needs 2-Step Verification on. Google shows it in four groups of four letters.
